description: Add, update or remove the website's global writing rules, the ones the Global rules tab holds and every brand kit and every future piece of content follows. Call get_brand_kit first: its global_rules carry the ids. Add new rules, update by id (omitted fields keep their value; category "" clears it), or remove by id. There is no draft: the change is live for all content generation as soon as it is saved, as a new version the Global rules tab's change history can restore. A rule that contradicts an existing global or kit rule is refused with the explanation and nothing is saved; when the result says the rules changed in another session, call get_brand_kit again and retry. Needs the writing rules feature on the plan. A rule meant for one kit only belongs in update_brand_kit, not here.
